components.name: Bento Card
components.description: The flat, rule-bound Archive Sheet container used throughout the portfolio.
components.html:
System title

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-paper-2); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; transition: transform var(--dur-short, 220ms) var(--ease-out, ease), border-color var(--dur-short, 220ms) var(--ease-out, ease); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 500 1.125rem/1.5 var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 0.875rem/1.625 var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

components.name: Technology Chip
components.description: A compact technical label for skills and project technologies.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 0.75rem/1.333 var(--font-fira), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: color var(--dur-micro, 120ms) ease, border-color var(--dur-micro, 120ms) ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Social Dock
components.description: The pill-shaped cluster for external profiles and theme control.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-paper-2) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-dock a, .ds-dock button { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--dur-micro, 120ms) var(--ease-out, ease); } .ds-dock a:hover, .ds-dock button:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-dock a:focus-visible, .ds-dock button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-dock svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-dock > span { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--color-rule); }

components.name: Theme Switch
components.description: The compact day/night control with a translating icon thumb.
components.css: .ds-theme { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 48px; height: 24px; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-rule); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--dur-short, 220ms) var(--ease-out, ease); } .ds-theme span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: transform var(--dur-long, 420ms) var(--ease-out, ease); } .ds-theme:hover { background: var(--color-neutral); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-theme svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Section Divider

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like a carefully maintained technical almanac: a cool-paper record where experience, systems, projects, and writing accumulate into one inspectable body of evidence. Its restraint gives the work authority; its bento composition makes different kinds of expertise legible without flattening them into a résumé table.

The voice is curious, practical, and collaborative, but never tentative. Confidence comes through lucid structure, specific technical detail, and the quiet rhythm of Inter paired with Fira Code. Creative departures are welcome when they illuminate software, data, AI, or product thinking; decoration without that connection does not belong.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, paper-like surfaces with a complete dark counterpart.
A four-column bento field that collapses deliberately to two columns and then one.
Inter for explanatory content and Fira Code for identity, metadata, and technical signals.
Signal Blue used sparingly to orient attention and identify interaction.
Creativity tied to engineering content, behavior, or evidence rather than fashionable decoration.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue identifies meaning or interaction; it is never a general-purpose wash, decorative glow, or large background field.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter explains; Fira Code identifies, indexes, or signals technical context. Do not set long descriptive passages in monospace.

rules.name: The Tonal Structure Rule
rules.body: Cards stay flat at rest; reserve visible shadows and blur for controls that truly float above the document.

dos: Do make creative choices earn their place by revealing engineering work, product thinking, data relationships, or meaningful interaction.
Do preserve the paper-and-ink hierarchy, with Signal Blue acting as a scarce navigational and semantic cue.
Do vary bento spans according to information weight and keep the mobile collapse intentional.
Do use precise details—labels, states, transitions, and evidence—to create personality.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and keep icon-only controls accessible by name.
donts: Don't default to generic AI-portfolio motifs such as gradient-mesh heroes, neon orbs, code rain, faux terminal windows, or decorative 3D objects.
Don't introduce glass panels, glows, shadows, or gradients unless they communicate a real layer, state, or product concept.
Don't turn every idea into an equal rounded card; preserve hierarchy through scale, span, whitespace, and selective border removal.
Don't decorate with invented metrics, client logos, dashboards, testimonials, or technical claims.
Don't confuse software-engineering creativity with cyberpunk styling; this portfolio should feel authored, credible, and specific to Aahad's work.
